dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #Yo, hey there, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Need some music? I'm in tip-top shape!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yeah! There's enough space and freedom — what a great rehearsal venue!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Uhh... If it's alright, I'd rather perform for you after I practice up.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: That'll give you the best listenin' experience.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: But thanks for your cheers! I'll do my best!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, right! After each rehearsal, I make sure to tidy up after myself.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Don't worry, I'll have this place like new!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hey, what are you sayin'?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If anything, I ought to be the one thanking YOU! Inviting me to your house, not tellin' me what I can and can't do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Sure! I've got some serious writer's block... Help me think it through!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Naturally!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: In Liyue Harbor, rock 'n' roll is considered niche. There's a lot of fans of the music, but few creators of it.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Although I listen to songs from Fontaine, that's just appreciation and learnin'.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: When it's time for creation, you gotta do it yourself to live up to the words "rock 'n' roll"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's amazing!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hehe, thanks for your appreciation.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: But... I've been kinda worried lately.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: For my newest song, fans say they can "hear tenderness within the searin' flames." They think my style has changed...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Maybe it's because of recent changes in my heart. Ugh, should I not let that happen...?

choices.text: In the past, what sort of themes did you start with?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Overcomin' prejudice, of course!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: What I heard and saw in the streets, combined with my personal experiences...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Narration, lyrics... The most important thing is to have enough passion to question everything!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: You gotta point right towards the soul!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Anything on your mind lately?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hm... Wanna try out the lyre?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You've seen and heard so many of my shows.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: If you're interested and wanna give it a fair go, I can teach you step by step!

choices.text: I've learned how to play instruments before.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Wow, really? That's great!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, at least for me, rock 'n' roll is somethin' as important as life itself.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If I could perform rock 'n' roll with you, that'd be twice as— no, the best thing in this world!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: O—Of course, I know that our music tastes won't be the same. The "rock 'n' roll" I'm thinkin' of here isn't limited to the music itself.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: If there's a part of you that's unwillin', I definitely won't force ya!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Aw...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Then I gotta live up to your faith in me and be a good teacher!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Here, this is my lyre.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Now get ready to train hard, because I'm about to turn up the heat!

choices.text: Maybe we can find another way of interpreting rock 'n' roll?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No. Prob. Lem!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Honestly... Just the fact that you're willin' to give it a try means a lot to me.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: After all, you're very special to me...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hehe... I look forward to us doin' "rock 'n' roll" together!

choices.text: I'm afraid that I won't play very well...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Don't sweat it, you got me helpin' you!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I'll pay attention to every method and every step... Although this is my first time actin' as a teacher.

choices.text: Why would you ask me to play?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Mornin'! I'm your gal if you need things fired up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #Looks like you also had a busy day, {NICKNAME}. Night.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, if you've got aches and pains, soak in a hot bath. It'll be comfy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Livin' a peaceful life in the countryside for years on end sounds suffocatin'.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I'll use my rock 'n' roll to bring 'em a new experience and stir up some long-lost enthusiasm!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No time to waste. C'mon, help me set a stage up!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Phew! Practice really tuckers me out. Gotta fill up on some food and drink!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wow, there's a lot of food here. I wanna try out each stall and see which feels the most rock 'n' roll!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You coming? I wanna see what floats your boat.
